description: Nine title templates with broadcast-grade presets: name and place lower thirds, speaker plates (two-line, ticker, caption bar, title card, corner tag), a podcast or show open, headline write-on reveals, a channel bumper animated on twos, CRT scanline, chrome echo melt and block-glitch title reveals. Presets give hold time from word count, safe areas for 16:9 and 9:16, type scale by frame height, tracking, plate opacity and enter/exit easing, from Netflix and BBC timing rules, EBU safe areas, Material motion, School of Motion, Art of the Title and the Spider-Verse animators. Use when a video needs a lower third, a name or location super, an intro title, a chapter card or a glitch/CRT/chrome text reveal. NOT for subtitles (use caption-styles) or logo animation of a brand mark.
